built_with: React Native 0.85 (TypeScript), with small Swift and Objective-C native modules

engine.text: Wallet logic is the app's own TypeScript in class/wallets/ (HD derivation, coin selection, PSBT building and signing). bitcoinjs-lib 7 with bip32, bip39 and ecpair does the Bitcoin work, on a @noble/secp256k1 adapter; chain data comes through a BlueWallet fork of the Electrum client.

chain_data.text: Electrum servers. The default is electrum1.bluewallet.io, falling back to a short hardcoded peer list; the person can enter any host and port under Settings > Network > Electrum server.

third_party.text: Nobody for on-chain funds: keys sign on the phone and any Electrum server relays the transaction. The optional Lightning (LNDhub, custodial) and Ark wallet types depend on their own servers.

distribution.text: App Store (the README links the App Store listing); the fastlane config uploads builds to TestFlight

libraries.text: bitcoinjs-lib, bip32, bip39, ecpair, @noble/secp256k1, BlueWallet forks of coinselect, rn-electrum-client, bip47, SilentPayments and slip39-js, aezeed, bolt11, payjoin-client, bc-ur (Keystone and NGRAVE), realm, react-native-keychain, @arkade-os/sdk and boltz-swap, Bugsnag.

bitcoin_library_not_counted: bitcoinjs-lib 7.0.1 from npm, with bip32 5.0.1 and @noble/secp256k1 3.1.0 for the curve operations

prebuilt.text: No binaries are checked in. The build links React Native's prebuilt Hermes and React-Core-prebuilt pods, and the patched react-native-background-fetch pod vendors the npm package's TSBackgroundFetch.xcframework.

patched: Four patch-package patches on npm packages: react-native-background-fetch (iOS xcframework with Catalyst), react-native-notifications (Android token), react-native-context-menu-view (Android menus), react-native-screens (iOS accessibility id; patch is for 4.27.0 while package.json pins 4.28.0). Several dependencies also come from BlueWallet forks pinned to git commits.
